name: Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textiles (Arni) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1964, Sri Lakshmi Saraswathi Textile Ltd manufactures yarn and surgical face masks.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SLSTL is engaged in the manufacture of all types of yarn used for manufacture of woven and knitted fabrics and is sold both in the domestic and international markets. It also manufactures surgical face masks and is engaged in generation of electricity from its windmills for its captive consumption.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.47% over past five years.
